missing_inputs: Exact gene lengths, filter list and normalization gene universe used for the published clock inputs, or a complete processed input matrix with provenance.
Intended transformation/correction path and library-preparation encoding, with uniquely keyed expected predictions for validation and recovery samples.
Sample-level induction, removal and harvest mapping resolving the short-induction timing discrepancy.
reopen_on: A complete exact preprocessing/reference bundle permits a separately frozen numerical replay with held-out reference checks.
Author clarification or a public sample map permits unambiguous long-withdrawal contrasts.
A newly available compatible dataset provides matched human age, identity and calibrated per-cell unusual-state measurements after verified withdrawal.
conditional_experimental_need: If the intended joint late per-cell recovery observations cannot be obtained from existing studies, those observations must be measured to test that claim. An ocular conclusion additionally requires relevant retinal/RPE biology and function. A finite public search does not prove that no suitable data exist elsewhere.
synthetic_and_model_training: Synthetic counts can test depth sensitivity, assignment failures and sampling rules. They cannot establish an unobserved biological recovery outcome. Supervised safety/state models still need suitable biological labels and held-out donor/study evaluation.
private_mail_status: Owned by coordinator; this public lane does not infer whether authors have replied.
